elena: Quick heads-up — I put together the release note draft for v2.3.0. Need ops/eng to confirm the rollforward/rollback wording and pinning details. Link: https://docs.internal/release/v2.3.0-draft

matt: looking now

deploybot: Automated: deploy plan queued. Stages: staging -> canary -> prod. Recommended command: `/deploy v2.3.0 --canary 10% --step 50%`

elena: updated draft below — small code block with the copy i'm planning to post internally. pls review fast

elena (draft):
```
Release 2.3.0 (internal)
- Summary: decoding and batching latency improvements; reduced inference cost per token.
- Model: redwood/open-3b@v2026-03-20 (pinned)
- Rollout: Canary 10% for 15m -> 50% for 1h -> 100% in next hour
- Rollback: automatic triggers: error rate > 2% OR P95 latency +200ms sustained for 10m. Manual rollback in ops runbook.
- Ops notes: monitor /dash/release-2.3.0, oncall: @matt, fallback model: redwood/open-3b@v2026-02-15
- Security: KMS-backed key rotation in place; no customer data retention changes.
- Internal announce: blast to #general and #product at 18:15 UTC after canary sanity pass
```
